body.name: schedule-to-observation laws
body.construction: In regime \(\mathsf B(p)\), \(Q^B_{P,p}=P R_{B,p}\) and the sample law is \((Q^B_{P,p})^{\otimes C}\). In regime \(\mathsf{CR}(\alpha)\), \(Q^{CR}_{P,C_C}=P^{\otimes C}R^{CR}_{C_C}\), equivalently the conditional product of stratum-specific observed laws given the randomized fixed-count label vector.
